One Year Limited Warranty

Home of the One Year Limited Warranty: 30 days parts and one year labor from the purchase date on store purchases. Here's exactly how it works.

First 30 Days

Repair or replacement at no cost. Parts and labor are both covered.

After 30 Days

Parts are not covered. Labor is free for one year when the appliance is brought to the Middleburg store — or $59 for an in-home service call.

The Details

  • Warranty claims are handled by repair or replacement.
  • If you didn't opt for delivery, bring the appliance back to the store or pay the $59 service-call fee.
  • There are no cash refunds after the point of sale.
  • A brand-new unit carries its manufacturer warranty, not the store's one-year limited warranty.
